abstract: Core guide for interacting with Euler Finance V2 protocol. Covers vault operations (deposit, borrow, repay), EVC orchestration (batching, sub-accounts, operators), risk management (health factors, liquidation), architecture concepts (vault types, market design), interest rate models, security practices, and developer tools. For specialized topics, see companion skills: euler-interest-rate-models-and-oracles, how-to-use-euler-swap, interact-with-euler-earn, use-euler-feeflow-hooks-rewardEUL-flashloan.
